patch_description:
Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The three vertices are retained as anchor points, while the remaining eight points are optimized inside the reference simplex using a fixed-seed differential-evolution phase followed by a batched local refinement phase.

The objective is evaluated directly as the minimum absolute determinant over all 165 triples. In barycentric reference coordinates this determinant is exactly the triangle area normalized by the area of the enclosing equilateral triangle, avoiding unnecessary geometric conversions during optimization. A final affine map converts the best reference-simplex arrangement back to the requested equilateral triangle. The fallback arrangement ensures a valid result if an unexpected numerical failure occurs.
